title: Treder2021 hippocampal switchboard: epoched intracranial EEG during object/scene localiser and associative recall (extra-hippocampal channels)
description: Epoched intracranial EEG from 11 epilepsy patients (22 recordings, about 9 hours of epochs at 200 Hz) recorded during an object/scene localiser task and an associative recall task. The data cover extra-hippocampal channels with anonymised labels and were repackaged from the authors' OSF release into BIDS. The dataset supports investigation of the hippocampus as a switchboard between perception and memory.
methods_description: FieldTrip epoch structures from the authors' OSF release were converted to BrainVision float32 files, with trials written back-to-back and trial information stored as events. Recordings were intracranial EEG sampled at 200 Hz during localiser and associative recall tasks; preprocessing is described in the source article.
